// Producer for TestTraceByIDandTraceQL at grafana/tempo
// 1a7373ee774b2ee5a40957c2310179b0ef7ff843. Run from that checkout with
// go run -mod=vendor /absolute/path/to/a-copy-of-this-file.go > trace-by-id.json
package main

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"time"

	"github.com/gogo/protobuf/proto"
	"github.com/golang/protobuf/jsonpb"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/v3/pkg/tempopb"
	common "github.com/grafana/tempo/v3/pkg/tempopb/common/v1"
	tempoUtil "github.com/grafana/tempo/v3/pkg/util"
	jaeger "github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger-idl/thrift-gen/jaeger"
	jaegerTrans "github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-contrib/pkg/translator/jaeger"
	"go.opentelemetry.io/collector/pdata/ptrace"
)

type collector struct{ wire []byte }

// This is the same ThriftToTraces conversion as the harness exporter, without
// the network transport. Concatenated ResourceSpans fields form one OTLP request.
func (c *collector) EmitBatch(_ context.Context, b *jaeger.Batch) error {
	t, err := jaegerTrans.ThriftToTraces(b)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	wire, err := (&ptrace.ProtoMarshaler{}).MarshalTraces(t)
	if err == nil {
		c.wire = append(c.wire, wire...)
	}
	return err
}

func main() {
	// Freeze only the random seed/clock. NewTraceInfos keeps its nanosecond
	// increments; Jaeger retains the original microsecond source precision.
	anchor := time.Unix(1793404800, 0)
	rows := []map[string]any{}
	for _, info := range tempoUtil.NewTraceInfos(anchor, 10, "") {
		c := &collector{}
		must(info.EmitAllBatches(c))
		expected, err := info.ConstructTraceFromEpoch()
		must(err)
		// Check independently executed write and expected reconstruction paths.
		written := &tempopb.Trace{}
		must(written.Unmarshal(c.wire))
		if !proto.Equal(written, expected) {
			panic("write/reconstruction mismatch")
		}
		text, err := (&jsonpb.Marshaler{}).MarshalToString(expected)
		must(err)
		queries := []string{}
		// Deterministically cover both branches of RandomAttrFromTrace, retaining
		// its non-integer, non-service, original-string equality query shape.
		batch := expected.ResourceSpans[0]
		for i, attrs := range [][]*common.KeyValue{batch.Resource.Attributes, batch.ScopeSpans[0].Spans[0].Attributes} {
			key := "vulture-process-0"
			if i == 1 {
				key = "vulture-0"
			}
			for _, attr := range attrs {
				if attr.Key == key {
					queries = append(queries, fmt.Sprintf(`{ .%s = %q}`, key, attr.Value.GetStringValue()))
					break
				}
			}
		}
		if len(queries) != 2 {
			panic("missing string search attributes")
		}
		rows = append(rows, map[string]any{
			"traceID": info.HexID(), "wire": base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(c.wire),
			"expected": json.RawMessage(text), "queries": queries,
		})
	}
	enc := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout)
	must(enc.Encode(map[string]any{"anchor": anchor.Unix(), "traces": rows}))
}

func must(err error) {
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
